verdicts.evidence: agents/verifier.md:574 — "Structured gaps in VERIFICATION.md frontmatter for the gap-closure planning workflow." (verifier names no downstream consumer or re-scoped step).
verdicts.reasoning: The agent structures gaps for consumption but does not name which step consumes them or how they combine with other assets. Routing verify's gap list together with converge's appended section and any EVAL-REVIEW.md BLOCKER into one re-scoped step-8 remediation wave is cross-asset orchestration that only the guide, sitting above all three assets, can state.

The command describes a single dispatch; it has no concept of being invoked a second time or of when re-invocation should happen relative to a remediation pass. "Then re-run /dev-kit-core:verify on the same phase goal" is ordering/re-invocation policy across steps that a single-run command cannot express about itself.
